purpose: Independently observe Creature Actor+104 initialization and negative Fatigue command eligibility
steps: Back up exact private Oblivion.ini and Plugins.txt bytes/modes/timestamps; verify executable, master, archive and pristine save hashes.

Disable private autosaves, load the private Continue-selected save, focus the isolated window and open the console. Record the selection separately from the protected pristine quicksave hash; Continue alone does not prove which save was loaded.
Enter player.placeatme 0001e5f5 1 and player.placeatme 00024ddb 1. Inspect complete command text before Enter when debugger overhead can drop fast input.
Record constructor byte0, model callback setter argument1 and post-load byte1 for each spawned reference, distinguishing base creature kind from actor state.
Select the newly spawned Dog reference reported by the observer; run getav fatigue, modav fatigue -5, getav fatigue while the console pauses simulation.

Detach the observer, exit via qqq, verify wrapper exit0, restore exact private inputs and preserve the pristine save hash. Identify owned Wine processes by WINEPREFIX; Steam can rewrite STEAM_COMPAT_DATA_PATH.
scope: Live constructor/model initialization and one console resource command. Contact damage, audio, flag persistence without model reconstruction and full M15S4 acceptance require separate evidence. Never overwrite the pristine save with F5.
